questions: Can each member pay any amount above zero in a round, or does everyone pay the same fixed amount each round? And can one member pay more than once in the same round?
Can any member who has not yet collected be chosen as collector, or must they also have paid into that round?
Do rounds have to go in order (for example, no payments to round 3 until round 2 is collected), or can payments be recorded for any round number at any time?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round. Yes, sometimes people pay in two parts; all of it counts toward that round.
